c74object.name: el.buffi~
c74object.digest: Dynamic buffer interpolation and function generation
c74object.description: el.buffi~ performs sample-accurate linear interpolation between two source buffer~ objects, writing the result into a destination buffer. It also provides several algorithmic methods for generating transfer functions (warping curves) directly into an existing buffer.

inlet.description: A control signal from 0.0 to 1.0. When the input signal is 1.0, the output buffer will contain the data from 'src1'. When the input signal is 0.0, the output buffer will contain the data from 'src2'. Values between 0.0 and 1.0 perform a linear interpolation between the two source buffers.

outlet.description: Pass-through of the input interpolation phase.

objarg.name: src1
objarg.description: The name of the first source buffer~.

objarg.name: src2
objarg.description: The name of the second source buffer~.

objarg.name: dest
objarg.description: The name of the destination buffer~.

method.name: reset
method.description: Re-bind the object to new source and destination buffers.

method.name: autofunc
method.description: Generates a buffer transfer function using randomized linear segments between min and max values.

method.name: autoexpfunc
method.description: Generates a buffer transfer function using randomized exponential segments.

method.name: autocurvefunc
method.description: Generates a buffer transfer function using randomized power-curve segments.

method.name: autospike
method.description: Populates a buffer with random impulses based on provided density odds.
